title: Internal Hom maps determined by total tensor summand restrictions
statement: Let C be a site, R a sheaf of commutative rings, and Mod(R) its category of sheaf modules. For cochain complexes K,L in Mod(R) put T=Tot(K tensor L) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], using the sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For every integer t and modules A,N, two morphisms f,g:A→internalHom(T^t,N) [def-pur-sheaf-hom] are equal if for every p,q with p+q=t their composites with precomposition by the summand inclusion ι_(p,q):K^p tensor L^q→T^t are equal. No differentials or currying maps of Hom complexes occur in this criterion.

source.place: Section 03EK and Lemma internal-hom-adjoint-tensor (Tag 03EO), with the coproduct universal property

proof.text: Use the total-degree cofan of tensor summands and the universal map constructor for HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor; its colimit property is proved by mapBifunctor.hom_ext and the ι_mapBifunctorDesc equations.
Apply internalHomCoproductFanIsLimit to this cofan. Fan hom_ext reduces equality of maps into the internal Hom to equality after every summand inclusion, exactly the hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Section 03EK and Lemma internal-hom-adjoint-tensor (Tag 03EO), via the total-degree cofan and internal-Hom fan limit

lean.statement:
theorem homTensorSummandRestriction_ext
    (K L : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) (t : ℤ) (A N : Mod) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
    let T := CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)
    ∀ (f g : A ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (T.X t) N),
      (∀ (p q : ℤ) (h : p + q = t),
        f ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
          (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod) p q t h) (𝟙 N) =
        g ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
          (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod) p q t h) (𝟙 N)) →
      f = g
